Categories of Institutes/Universities (For all posts)
Category-I Institutions
IITs, NITS, 111Ts, IISc/IISERs/Central Universities/lnstitutions of higher learning of
Government of India such as TIFR/TISS, Foreign Universities ranked among top 750
Universities/lnstitutions in the world as per the QS/Times ranking or top 25
Universities/lnstitutions ranked as per the NIRF ranking.
Category-II Institutions
All other NITS, IIT s, IITs, CFTIs, not covered under Category-I, State government
institutions/State universities, Reputed private funded deemed Universities such as BITS
Pilani/BIT Ranchi/Thapar University, VIT Vellore.
Also, other private universities ranked in the top 750 as per QS/Times ranking or top 25
ranked NIRF institutes.
Category-III Institutions
All other Universities and Institutions not covered under Category-I and Category-II.
Note: Ifa Ph.D. was awarded prior to the inception of the NIRF ranking/QS/Times ranking,
then the present ranking would be used to classify the Category of Institutes.
